newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Cetis debut postponed to March 10.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Cetis debut postponed to March 10.

text.p: The debut of Slovenian graphic firm Cetis has been postponed to March 10 and the shares will now be listed on the over-the-counter section of the Ljubljana bourse not the first section, the bourse said on Friday.
Cetis, which was expected to be listed on Friday, would be moved to the OTC because it failed to supply the bourse with the required information on time, the bourse said.
The company will list 190,746 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 12,000 tolars ($7.8) each, representing 84.3 percent of its equity.
Cetis joins a batch of 30 companies that have been listed on the main or the OTC markets of the fledgling bourse since January 1996.
Currently there are 26 shares traded on the main market, and 32 on the OTC segment. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
